text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Truly a magnificent battle of blood and 
spirit...! My throbbing heartbeat is proof 
of that...!!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: My gratitude to all the shining stars—

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Indeed!! The God of Destruction shall 
awaken time and again. As long as beloved 
souls shine across this world—

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
"Next time," I will crush you. And you 
will remember.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
...to see who can truly change the world 
the most.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: —I have no intention of stepping aside.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: "That is how it must be. ――My destiny."
